quote.text: Nescire autem quid ante quam natus sis acciderit, id est semper esse puerum.
quote.english: To be ignorant of what happened before you were born is to remain a child forever.

poem.text:
空山不見人，但聞人語響。
返景入深林，復照青苔上。
poem.english:
There seems to be no one on the empty mountain…
And yet I think I hear a voice,
Where sunlight, entering a grove,
Shines back to me from the green moss.
poem.note: Twenty characters that have been translated into English more than a hundred times, no two alike. Nobody agrees where the light is coming from.
poem.translator: Witter Bynner & Kiang Kang-hu, The Jade Mountain, 1929

painting.title: The Monk by the Sea
painting.note: Kleist wrote that looking at it felt as though his eyelids had been cut away. Friedrich painted out the ships he had first put on the horizon, leaving nothing between the figure and the sky.

song.title: Blade Runner Blues
song.note: Recorded live to picture, improvised while the film ran, which is why it breathes with the city rather than under it.
